# SEO MCP: Use SE Ranking’s live data inside any AI assistant

 Put 180+ SEO tools behind every prompt: keyword data, backlinks, domain insights, audits, and more — all inside your favorite AI assistant.

![SE Ranking MCP](https://seranking.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/9/2026/06/image-14-media-scaled.png)

## Ask ChatGPT your SEO questions, answered with live data

 ChatGPT can talk about search, but it can’t see your numbers. Connect SE Ranking and give it live keyword, site audit, and backlink data to work from.

![](https://seranking.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/9/2026/06/image-16-media.png)

### Your SE Ranking data, working inside ChatGPT

 Add SE Ranking from the ChatGPT connector directory, then query your keywords, backlinks, domain performance, and site audits. Get answers backed by live data from your account, not the model’s best guess.

[ Add the connector ](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/se-ranking)

## SE Ranking MCP use cases for everyday workflows

 Let your AI assistant reason, compare, and analyze with live SE Ranking data behind every answer.

![Keyword research with SE Ranking MCP](https://seranking.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/9/2026/05/keyword_research_visual-media.png)

### Find keyword ideas worth targeting

 Discover high-potential keyword ideas for your niche, then compare them by demand and recent trends to choose the best content angles.

**Example prompt:**
“Find 50 keyword ideas for [seed keyword] in [country], including related, similar, long-tail, and question-based keywords. Show search volume, CPC, competition, difficulty, and 6-month trend data. Group them by intent and highlight the top 10 opportunities for new content.

FAQ

Q

## What is an MCP server?

A

An MCP server is a connector that lets AI assistants access external tools and data sources. SE Ranking MCP connects your AI assistant to live SE Ranking data (including keyword research, backlink analysis, website audits, and domain analysis) so you can ask SEO questions in plain language and get data-backed answers.

Q

## Do I need a developer to set it up?

A

No. SE Ranking MCP is hosted and managed by SE Ranking. You only need to add the MCP server URL to your AI client and authorize the connection. No local installation, Docker setup, or code required. The process usually takes under two minutes.

Q

## Is SE Ranking MCP included in my current plan?

A

Yes. MCP access is included in every SE Ranking subscription. The amount of data you can pull depends on the [SE Ranking’s API](https://seranking.com/api.html) credits available in your [pricing plan](https://seranking.com/subscription.html).

Q

## Which AI tools does SE Ranking MCP support?

A

SE Ranking MCP works with AI tools that support MCP connections, including Claude Web, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Codex, Zed, Gemini CLI, and others.

Q

## What data is available through the MCP?

A

SE Ranking MCP gives your AI assistant access to 180+ SEO tools, including those for keyword research, domain analysis, backlink data, website audits, and more.

## Your AI assistant is one connection away from live SEO data

 SE Ranking MCP gives Claude, Cursor, and any compatible AI tool direct access to 180+ research tools with keyword data, backlinks, domain analysis, and competitor analysis. Included in every plan. No code. No middleware.
